svg.title: GenePT-informed spatial transformer for spot-level segmentation
svg.desc: All-gene sparse expression is encoded independently for each spot using frozen GenePT vectors, expression-weighted mean pooling and a trainable 1536 to 256 projection. Relative spatial positions are added. Fifty tokens enter a 32-layer transformer, followed by centre-spot direction and foreground heads.

g.text: Whole-slide learning with spot-resolved inputs and predictions
All source genes considered; no 6,000-gene cutoff
GenePT-mapped genes enter the expression encoder
GenePT expression encoder · applied independently to every spot
Computed online; no full-slide 1,536-dimensional spot cache
Spatial context modelling and centre-spot prediction
One prediction pair per centre spot
GenePT: frozen · Projections, Transformer and heads: trainable
PyTorch · BF16 mixed precision · SDPA · Muon (hidden matrices) + AdamW (other parameters)
